notes.title: Introducing Penny Larceny: Gig Economy Supervillain!
notes.content:
Arcade Spirits fans, rejoice! Our next visual novel is on the way...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359683/2d0b227de6dc0758b416222585b4053dd2ba8534.jpg[/img]

It's a world of heroes and villains, masks and capes, and Penny Larceny -- grifter, con artist, catburglar -- is barely scraping by. Life's hard for a young mask trying to make it big, but now she's gained access to Crimr, the gig-economy service for henchpersons looking to help supervillains with their evil, evil schemes! Guide Penny through her new career, pull off daring heists, and unravel the conspiracies which allow the rich and powerful to maintain their profitable status quo.

[h3][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2227030/Penny_Larceny_Gig_Economy_Supervillain/]Wishlist on Steam today![/url][/h3]

By doing this one-click task, you help us defeat THE ALGORITHM(tm). Who doesn't enjoy defeating THE ALGORITHM(tm)?

notes.title: Arcade Spirits: The New Challengers is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h2]Welcome back retro romancers![/h2]

In case you missed our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/910630/view/3203756329355632294]last post[/url], Fiction Factory Games has teamed up again with PQube to release an all-new [i]Arcade Spirits[/i] adventure, [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1484620/Arcade_Spirits_The_New_Challengers/]Arcade Spirits: The New Challengers[/url][/i]. Check out our [b]launch trailer below:[/b]

[previewyoutube=u4WBnU7XXBQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Continue your story and head on down to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1484620/view/4754088250738768693]Good Clean Fun[/url], your home for everything pizza, laundry, and arcade related! Created by couple Ben and Matt, this trio-stablishment is a one-of-a-kind hang out spot for you and your future team. Meet the arcade whiz kids that frequent GCF, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1484620/view/5299049807141665960]Domino[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1484620/view/5299049807142458204]Grace[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1484620/view/5299049807160209374]Jynx[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1484620/view/3114804524534015579]Locksley[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1484620/view/3114804524555670811]Rhapsody[/url], and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1484620/view/3121561825584172895]Zapper[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40185640/771270506c2e0de8aea4d3625c02ba902f10e0d3.png[/img]

All of these candidates have the potential to become inseparable friends, or even romantic partners. In [i]Arcade Spirits: The New Challengers[/i] you have the option to choose exactly how your friendships develop. Your handy AI companion, Iris, will ask you about your preferences. Are you actively looking for love, open to the idea of a potential relationship, or just here for the thrill of the arcade?

Personality is everything in [i]Arcade Spirits: The New Challengers[/i]. As you progress through the story you'll be faced with several decisions that influence your growing personality, reflected in the traits [b]Quirky[/b], [b]Steady[/b], [b]Kindly[/b], [b]Gutsy[/b], and [b]Flexible[/b]. Your decisions will not only determine how well you get on with other characters, but will also influence [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1484620/view/3121562460592744516]your skills in battle[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40185640/81cf540d1988b6c7e037f0d01a738333841fcea2.gif[/img]

[i]Arcade Spirits: The New Challengers[/i] also has a wonderfully diverse [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1484620/view/3121562460573873106]character creator[/url] complete with an extensive list of body types, pronouns, clothing, and accessories. Changed your mind about your arcade avatar? No worries! Make adjustments at the end of every story chapter. 

And remember, for those of you that have completed the original [i]Arcade Spirits[/i], you can import your save and see unique interactions, cameos, easter eggs and more based on your previous actions!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1484620/Arcade_Spirits_The_New_Challengers/][b]Arcade Spirits: The New Challengers[/b][/url] is out NOW!

notes.title: Arcade Spirits: The New Challengers - 1 Week to go!
notes.content:
[h2]Welcome back challengers![/h2]

As some of you will know, we've been hard at work on our standalone sequel, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1484620/Arcade_Spirits_The_New_Challengers/][i][b]Arcade Spirits: The New Challengers[/b][/i][/url], and we're excited to announce that we are now just [b]1 week away from launch![/b] For those that are interested to know more about the new entry, we've put together an overview of what you can expect!

Remember that save files from your original [i][b]Arcade Spirits[/b][/i] experience will carry over and affect your time in [i][b]Arcade Spirits: The New Challengers[/b][/i], you may see some familiar faces and discover some fun Easter eggs as well!

[h3]The Dream Team[/h3]

Embark on your quest for esports glory by teaming up with new challengers on the arcade scene. Get to know your teammates in our [b]character trailer: [/b]

[previewyoutube=bMSRZPI2HoQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Each of these arcade pros can be befriended and even romanced! They make for great company as you climb the ranks on the pro tour.

You'll also have a handy helper, [b]Iris[/b], who will be there to help with decision making, as well as guide you towards victory. As an AI she is totally unbiased... unless, of course, you're talking about the best way to enjoy pizza...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359683/771270506c2e0de8aea4d3625c02ba902f10e0d3.png[/img]

[h3]The New YOU[/h3]

Who doesn't love a [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1484620/view/3121562460573873106]character creator[/url][/b]? We've improved and expanded customization options so that you can create some truly individual player characters. There are tonnes of options to choose from including body types, features, pronouns, and accessories. 

Don't worry, if you ever feel like changing things up, you can alter your character at the end of each chapter!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359683/addef6a49982ef8548e0bdd6ca3cfed0d6ce00c1.gif[/img]

[h3]Your Arcade Spirits Personality[/h3]

The decisions you make, including how you interact with those around you are a huge part of the [i][b]Arcade Spirits: The New Challengers[/b][/i] experience. Not only will your choices determine how your relationships develop with other characters, but also how your story unfolds. Your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1484620/view/3121562460592744516][b]personality[/b][/url] is woven into every outcome in the game, so choose carefully! 

Iris will give you an update on how your personality is shaping up after every chapter so that you can easily track your progress.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359683/f4a118a05fe9cae065be7e63b0644d1b80a9cd04.png[/img]

[h3]Introducing Good Clean Fun[/h3]

Ah the smell of pizza, the thrill of the arcade and the... laundromat? [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1484620/view/4754088250738768693][b]Good Clean Fun[/b][/url] is the main location you'll be visiting on your travels and home to the wonderful Ben and Matt, a married couple offering a slice of life (and 'za). This is where you'll meet your future teammates and train to become esports champions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359683/a982ab4a8e87d519add1977de392153c60d104e0.gif[/img]

[h3]Mastering [i]Fist of Discomfort 2[/i][/h3]

[b]Fist of Discomfort 2[/b] is the latest arcade machine to take the world by storm. Learn everything there is to know about the game on everyone's lips with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1484620/view/3114804524538206859][b]this handy guide[/b][/url] detailing how to play, and offering up some sneaky tactics to ensure you rise to the top! There's more than meets the eye to this narratively driven mini-game as the outcome will influence your ultimate destiny...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359683/bc1a4925a2d06fca14edc03c8ce2abb41d622910.jpg[/img]

[h3]Building a Retro Romance[/h3]

As previously mentioned, you'll encounter several other players during your time at [b]Good Clean Fun[/b]. These characters will become your closest friends and teammates, and can even be [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1484620/view/3121562460574311617][b]your next romantic partner[/b][/url]. Your trusty AI companion, Iris, will be there every step of the way to let you know how well you're getting on with each of them, and who might be crushing on who!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359683/e8ce841033e52a740474214f80770d95f385a4e9.jpg[/img]

And that's everything! You're all caught up and ready to begin the next chapter in the [i][b]Arcade Spirits[/b][/i] saga.

Lead a new generation of challengers to esports glory in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1484620/Arcade_Spirits_The_New_Challengers/][i][b]Arcade Spirits: The New Challengers[/b][/i][/url], launching on [b]May 27th 2022[/b]!

notes.title: HERE COMES A NEW CHALLENGER!
notes.content:
Hello, hello! 


We're thrilled to be bringing Arcade Spirits: The New Challengers demo to Steam.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359683/e720e7c860bcc10d8fe6ae4af00fe43ce24ac4b2.jpg[/img]

Arcade Spirits: The New Challengers is a follow-up to 2019's Arcade Spirits, a visual novel of love and pixels, in which you seek friendship and romance while working in an arcade. Now the tables are turned, as you seek friendship and romance while PLAYING in an arcade!

This romantic comedy visual novel demo is live from today, 30th March 2021, giving you plenty of time to get hands-on with the game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1484620/Arcade_Spirits_The_New_Challengers/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359683/c1fe5cb294a2db620a04e602704a0ed75c796e3d.jpg[/img]

With its gorgeous visuals, the neon lights and buzzing atmosphere of the Good Clean Fun, we think you'll be as hooked on the story of an aspiring gamer searching for esports glory on the Fist of Discomfort 2 Pro Tour. Defeat rivals, conquer tournaments, build relationships, and uncover a strange conspiracy at the Good Clean Fun arcade. In Arcade Spirits: The New Challengers it's up to you to rally together a team and achieve your dreams!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359683/ec2f16f6e1d450e186f4b72d31c7582edf2019ac.gif[/img]

We will be sharing exciting footages from Fiction Factory and PQube here on the Store Page, so be sure to check it out!

Hope you enjoy them! Follow, wishlist, like, share, subscribe, smash that bell, all the usual stuff so you can stay on top of all things Arcade Spirits-y.

notes.title: Arcade Spirits 2.0
notes.content:
Arcade Spirits 2.0 contains a bucketful of polish to shine things up real nice. Nothing major, but you'll get a better experience overall.

[list][*]Fixed all reported typos. (If you spot any left, let us know.)
[*]Clarified a few unclear or misleading decisions. (A little rewording goes a long way.)
[*]Improved visual impairment mode support. (Tap V key to turn on self-voicing. The character creator's been expanded for this mode.)
[*]Adjusted language in a few places. (Some lines were unintentionally dodgy and problematic.)
[*]Swapped placeholder sequel teases with full references to Arcade Spirits: The New Challengers. (Didja know we're making a sequel? Hit [url=http://www.arcadespirits.com]arcadespirits.com[/url] for more deets.)[/list]

notes.title: Arcade Spirits v1.5
notes.content:
This update provides general housekeeping for bugs and typos, and introduces an extensive new system to make the game more accessible to visually impaired players.

[list][*]Many, many typos fixed. Long time coming!
[*]A few obscure bugs fixed.
[*]Some sound effects are quieter, to be less blaring.
[*]Game engine updated to a more modern version of RenPy.
[*]Completionist ending updated.[/list]

For visually impaired players, we have improvements to our audio-only mode! To activate, press the V key on your keyboard while on the main menu. This is a beta test of this feature, so your feedback is welcome. With this turned on before you start the game, you'll get access to these features:

[list][*]Rollback is automatically unlocked and activated if you start a game using self-voicing.
[*]Additional accessibility-related tutorials are added to the start of the game.
[*]On-screen images or animations not already described in the text are now described properly.
[*]Images in text such as icons or symbols are now voiced correctly.
[*]The character creator is streamlined, to make entering name and pronoun easier.
[*]If you're streaming the game, sighted players can still see the visuals as you play.[/list]

(Note that the DEMO of the game does not yet have these features, just the full game.)

All of this is to bring the game up to speed with the upcoming game console release, coming to Nintendo Switch, Sony PlayStation 4, and XBox One. And stick around in 2020, when we'll be announcing our next game project, currently code named "Next Fiasco." Great stuff is on the horizon! Watch our Twitter, @ArcadeSpiritsVN, for more news.

notes.title: Arcade Spirits v1.01
notes.content:
Patch notes, y'all! We fixed a few things tonight.

[list]
[*] Fixed a Gutsy response to Teo in Level 07 crashing the game.
[*] Fixed an incorrect side image in Level 07.
[*] Removed an unintended slur from Level 04. Apologies for that!
[*] Fixed Hamza appearing in the wrong place during Level 02.
[*] Re-organized a few lines for better comedic timing.
[*] Various typo fixes. (If you spot any more, let us know!)
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Updated With Voice!
notes.content:
​Good news -- the updated version of the Arcade Spirits demo is now available! Here's a list of what's new.
[list]
[*]Voice acting is now available! In the full game several key scenes will be fully acted, and emotional reaction lines are used elsewhere; for the demo we're only using the emotional reaction lines.
[*]Music and sound effect volume has been rebalanced.
[*]Teo is slightly smaller (he was too zoomed in before).
[*]Teo and QueenBee's Kindly paths have additional character details.
[/list]
The full game releases February 12, 2019! So enjoy the demo, and we hope to see you then!

notes.title: Help Ashley Find Her Voice!
notes.content:
For those waiting to hear about open casting calls for Arcade Spirits, the time has come! Ashley Wolf, dedicated cosplayer and floor attendant for Francine's Arcade Funplex, needs your help!Are you a voice talent who thinks they have what it takes to help Ashley express her love of cosplay, arcade games, and weekend bingo night fiestas? Let's find out.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33359683/8ece9dd94c775fd5a363a9075e55202bf5210913.jpg[/img]

[b]THE RULES ARE AS FOLLOWS! Any audition not following these rules exactly will be ignored[/b] and left behind, dwindling towards the horizon while sad piano music plays.

notes.title: Arcade Spirits Demo Update for 8/30/2018
notes.content:
This small update adds two new features:

1. Animated backgrounds! The arcade lights pulse and glow, the crane machine moves up and down, city lights blink on and off. You can adjust the speed of these animations from the Preferences menu, keeping them slow and subtle, or making them fast and lively -- or turning them off completely.

2. Added visual examples of our three UI styles to the Preferences menu (Neon, Pixel, Basic). This option was always here, we just didn't have a good quick reference for what each of them meant.

notes.title: Who We Are / Yummy Arcade Preserves
notes.content:
Ever since the PQube announcement, we've had new folks tuning in to see what Arcade Spirits is all about. Hello, new folks! We've got a blog (which we mirror to [url=http://stefangagne.tumblr.com/]Tumblr[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/910630/announcements/]Steam[/url]), we've got a [url=https://twitter.com/ArcadeSpiritsVN]Twitter[/url] for announcements and arcade culture tidbits, a [url=https://discord.gg/gaCcH2N]Discord[/url] to connect with other arcade fans, a [url=http://patreon.com/stefangagne]Patreon[/url] if you want to support us on a deeper level, and finally a [url=http://www.arcadespirits.com]website[/url]. That's a lot of stuff! Just pick your favorite way to follow us, and enjoy.

But also, [url=http://stefangagne.com/2018/04/30/the-pillars-of-arcade-spirits/]I'd like to direct you to an old blog post[/url] you probably missed, which describes the pillars of our game, and why we made the choices we did when designing the game. To summarize so you don't HAVE to go digging through the blog if you don't wanna, we've got four guiding principles in telling our lighthearted tale of love and quarters...
[list]
 	[*][b]We’re inclusive by not restricting player choice of romance.[/b] Be who you want to be, romance who you want to romance (or nobody at all). We're LGBTQ+ friendly without specifically being a game about LGBQT+. Notably: coding in restrictions based on your preferred pronoun takes effort and we're too lazy for that. But it's laziness in favor of player choice, so hey![/*]
 	[*][b]We want you to be able to choose how to react to things around you.[/b] Player agency is sometimes missing in visual novels, so we want as much as we can pour in. We focus heavily on roleplaying and self-expression, letting you react as you like.[/*]
 	[*][b]There should be clear signposts for easy decision-making.[/b] We don't like blind choices, or needing to play with a FAQ open on your second monitor. We're going to be relatively clear what each choice is going to mean for you -- who you'll spend time with and how they'll react. You have some leeway, too, so you don't have to scoop up EVERY point to get the ending you want.[/*]
 	[*][b]One tale, with your own personal path chosen from beginning to end.[/b] We'll say up front this isn't about massively branching paths and multiple distinct endings. It's about a personal experience that's never exactly the same as any other player's, thanks to the choices you make along the way and who you decide to be.[/*]
[/list]
We're aiming to deliver one heck of a tale for you, a story that you participate in rather than passively read, a story you can insert yourself into or play whatever other personality type you like. Play things straight, romance or don't, get wild, be snarky, do as you want. And we hope you enjoy that story.

...

Okay! That's our introduction out of the way. Let's talk this week's actual (slightly depressing) topic, based on Recent Topical News -- specifically Nintendo squishing several ROM and emulation sites with legal papers. Pirated retro games are no longer quite so easy to find, thanks to their actions.

In Arcade Spirits we've added a mini-documentary hosted by Naomi which is all about building your own emulation cabinet. It's pretty detailed on the hardware and software you'll need, but one thing we skim over is obtaining ROMs -- because let's be totally honest here, Nintendo and their ilk have every legal right to say "Hey, uh, please stop giving away our games for free, okay?" You just can't condone that sort of thing, not if you work in the game industry like I do. There's no ethical leg to stand on.

But unfortunately, this also poses a serious problem for video game preservation efforts. Many of these games are a tangled mess of copyright holders, many of which are out of business or were sold again and again, to the point where it's unclear WHO owns the copyright on a game anymore. Therefore, there is no legal way to play some of these games short of tracking down original arcade hardware and spending hundreds to thousands of dollars on it -- and if that hardware is just flat out gone, cabinets junked and sitting in landfills, a game can be lost forever. Look at the movie industry, where the majority of films from the dawn of cinema in the 30s are simply gone, because nobody thought to preserve them.

Emulation and abandonware archives were one way to keep those dimly lit and flickering candles alive. Legal? No, but given the copyright holders cannot -- or in many cases, will not -- provide a legal means of obtaining the game, not many options remain. Even games which aren't exactly in danger of vanishing can be withheld... Scott Pilgrim vs. The World is a good recent example. It never had a physical release, only digital downloads, and as licenses expired it was pulled from digital storefronts. You literally cannot legally obtain this game anymore and likely never will be able to again, and because it was loaded on DRM-locked modern game consoles, any act of preservation runs afoul of the DMCA.

So... what to do? There's really not a good solution in the hands of gamers. And again, I can't and won't condone piracy. It's up to the companies involved to be willing to loosen their grip on these games, and many refuse to budge. As noted, they're even actively fighting websites that preserve games. And thus, an impasse.

Hopefully we as an industry will find a way past this issue, to make these classic games available conveniently and without legal problems. Either that, or as fans of arcade classics, we'll have to mourn the passing of more and more great games.
